Present now: cells, instance_level, reference_phi, runs_example, floors, scaling_fit, phi_error, paired_diff, h1_contrast, mstar_by_margin (+mstar_fit, mstar_per_instance), guidance, sensitivity, certificate, certificate_summary, validity. **Not yet:** background_sensitivity.csv (jobs still running; separate push).
  > 
  > Names that differ from the contract (please follow mine):
  > - `estimator` = `shap_kernel` (the unchanged `shap.KernelExplainer`, with `l1_reg` ∈ False / auto / num_features(10)), `kernel_paired`, `permutation_antithetic`; `l1_reg`=NA for the last two. `is_default_budget` marks the shap default (2d+2048). `kind` ∈ topk1, topk3, topk5, sign.
  > - instance_level: `n_correct`, `n_correct_tol` (ε=0.05), plus `n_correct_tol_e002`, `n_correct_tol_e010`; `mean_spearman_abs` is Spearman on |φ|. sensitivity: `eps` ∈ {0 (exact), 0.02, 0.05, 0.1} × `threshold` × `kind`; headline CIs are instance bootstrap there.
  > - floors.parquet: `floor` a_run rows exist for every estimator/budget with R>1 (`n_models`=R); b/c rows have `budget_m`=-1, `estimator`=exact_explanation. Per-model n and K in `floors_models.csv`.
  > - paired_diff labels are B_higher / B_lower / not_resolved; contrasts `kernel_paired_vs_shap_kernel`, `perm_antithetic_vs_shap_kernel`, budget m1 vs m2. mstar_by_margin and guidance carry `criterion` (pc_exact / pc_eps).
  > - R1 is in its own files because the shape differs: `certificate.parquet` (`m` = coalitions of each run-twice run; the certificate run has 2m; scores are calibrated probabilities; `unstable_outcome` = 1 − correct of the certificate run; `split` heldout_instance / loo_dataset), `certificate_summary.csv` (long: method certificate / run_twice / run_twice_avg; `model`='all' pools over models; `m`='all' pools the ladder; Brier+CI, AUROC, base_rate, brier_skill), `certificate_bins.csv`, `certificate_paired_diff.csv`, `certificate_budget_rule.csv`, `certificate_coverage.csv`.
  > 
  > Cut / partial cells (absent = not run; draw as absent): R = 100 except German LR 30, German and ACS-Employment MLP 60, ACS-Employment LR 30; d ≤ 10 default budgets are exact enumeration with R=1; German GBM has 37 of 40 instances for now; m ∈ {32,64,128} exist for LR/MLP at d ≥ 16 only (RF/GBM follow); floors for German MLP (n=10, K=6) and ACS-Employment MLP are pending; floors on the other cells use all instances, K=10 (some retrain filters keep fewer, see floors_models.csv).
